district_name: Wells Springs Unified Union School District

jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(4)(B) inventory: Wells Springs Unified Union School District (the statute prints "Wells Spring"; the district's own documents use the plural, which controls), a unified union district in the Greater Rutland County Supervisory Union (member towns: Middletown Springs, Wells). Operates PK-6; tuitions grades 7-12.
Greater Rutland County Supervisory Union (official site).

board.org_name: Wells Springs Unified Union School Board
board.post_note: Wells Springs UUSD: seven directors, residency allocated Middletown Springs 3 / Wells 3 / at-large 1, all elected by both towns' voters on a categorized ballot (modified at-large, Articles Art. 9). Per-member towns and ends are unpublished.

sources.note: Wells Springs UUSD Articles of Agreement (official, via GRCSU), Art. 9: a seven-member board -- Middletown Springs 3, Wells 3, At-Large 1 -- under an "at-large hybrid model": "All voters in both member towns vote on the same slate of candidates. The ballot is categorized to represent each town's apportioned seats" (modified at-large); Art. 10: 3-year terms, Australian ballot. The current roster is the GRCSU Board Information page's "Wells Springs Board" (fetched 2026-10-22): Montbriand (Chair), Morgan (Vice Chair), Weeden (Clerk), Burke, Fowler, Gonda, Plunkett -- corroborated for Montbriand by the district's FY27 budget letter and his Feb. 13, 2026 Senate Education testimony as chair. NO official source fetched publishes per-member towns or term ends -- none are minted. Turnover: the district's March 6, 2024 letter signs Haynes and Heering, who have since departed, and Fowler and Plunkett have joined, at undocumented dates/mechanisms -- no ended records. NAME: the district's own documents style it "Wells Springs" (plural); 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(4)(B) prints "Wells Spring" -- the district's own name controls.
